questions_and_answers.question_text: What do you say in this situation? There is a nice necktie in a showcase near you that you want to look at more closely. (Use 'kono' since it's near you.)

What do you say in this situation? A camera in the showcase behind the clerk looks like the one you have been looking for, so you want to look at it more closely. (Use 'sono' since it's near the clerk.)
What do you say in this situation? There is a small clock in a showcase (not near you) that you want to look at more closely. (Use 'ano' since it's away from both of you.)
What do you say in this situation? There is a nice-looking sweater on the top shelf behind the clerk that you want to look at more closely. (Use 'sono'.)
What do you say in this situation? A brooch in a showcase which is not near you or the clerk looks very nice and you want to look at it more closely. (Use 'ano'.)
What do you say in this situation? There is a camera on the bottom shelf behind the clerk which you want to look at more closely. (Use 'sono'.)
What do you say in this situation? There is an attractive scarf in a showcase near you that you want to look at more closely. (Use 'kono'.)
